name: HPGL (Graphtec / generic)
_comment: HPGL is Hewlett-Packard's published plotter language. HE=IN; is the header and FD=!PG; the feed/eject footer; XU=40 YU=40 is 40 plotter units per mm. The move and draw command forms (MC=PU;PA%.0f,%.0f; and LC=PD%.0f,%.0f;) are built into the HPGL post-processor, so they are not repeated here. This profile declares no serial settings and no force/speed values, so the machine keeps its front-panel settings: the machine keeps its front-panel settings. Set max_x_mm/max_y_mm for your plotter's real travel to get an out-of-bounds refusal instead of a carriage crash.
_tool_comment: HPGL is a pen language first. A plotter pen has no drag-knife trail, so blade_offset_mm stays 0. If this profile drives a vinyl cutter in HPGL emulation mode, raise blade_offset_mm to 0.25-0.35 for a 45/60 degree blade.
